hypothesis: Instruction count is dominated by fixed attribute-assignment overhead, new cache-list construction, and disposal of previous cache lists. The varying index values should not materially affect reset cost.

pcvs.name: cache_slots
pcvs.rationale: Captures the work of allocating and filling the two feature-cache lists.

pcvs.name: existing_cache_slots
pcvs.rationale: Captures disposal of existing cache lists and distinguishes initial cache creation from subsequent resets.
